Guest is fully responsible for all damages.DETAILS: Escape for sun-drenched fun at She Winds! Less than 200 feet from beach access in beautiful Seagrove Beach, this fabulous 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Picture a getaway filled with swims in the private pool, views of the Gulf, evening barbecues, and long days at the beach—only a 1-minute walk away!A pale coastal aesthetic splashed with bright, resort-inspired colors creates a charmed retreat inside this 3-level home. The first floor hosts comfortable sleeping accommodations, including 2 bedrooms with king beds and a cheerful den with a queen sleeper sofa. Step outside to a private oasis, where friends and family will find a heated pool, grilling station, sun loungers, and the cool shade of a striped umbrella positioned above a round table. After a beach trip, wash away the day's sand with an enclosed outdoor shower.In the second-level great room, an open layout makes it easy for guests to move between spaces. The fully equipped kitchen’s high-end appliances invite fresh, homemade meals to enjoy at the table for 10, with 3 extra seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, sink into the plush sectional sofa or 2 armchairs for a chill night of TV. The covered balcony is furnished with a 6-person table and 2-person bistro set—perfect for alfresco dining or indulging in a sunset cocktail. This level has 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively.The third-floor bunk room is excellent for children with 2 full-over-full bunk beds, a private bathroom, 2 TVs, and a 4-person table for activities or board games. On the balcony, catch glimpses of the glimmering Gulf waters from rocking chairs.Across the pool deck, the private Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, a living space with a queen sleeper sofa, a 2-person table, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Enjoy an amazing Seagrove Beach vacation at She Winds. Easily explore with on-site parking and 7 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, take the crosswalk to the right of the property, and Dothan Beach Access will be at the end of Dothan Avenue. DETAILS: Escape for sun-drenched fun at She Winds! Less than 200 feet from beach access in beautiful Seagrove Beach, this fabulous 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Picture a getaway filled with swims in the private pool, views of the Gulf, evening barbecues, and long days at the beach—only a 1-minute walk away! A pale coastal aesthetic splashed with bright, resort-inspired colors creates a charmed retreat inside this 3-level home. The first floor hosts comfortable sleeping accommodations, including 2 bedrooms with king beds and a cheerful den with a queen sleeper sofa. Step outside to a private oasis, where friends and family will find a heated pool, grilling station, sun loungers, and the cool shade of a striped umbrella positioned above a round table. After a beach trip, wash away the day's sand with an enclosed outdoor shower. In the second-level great room, an open layout makes it easy for guests to move between spaces. The fully equipped kitchen’s high-end appliances invite fresh, homemade meals to enjoy at the table for 10, with 3 extra seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, sink into the plush sectional sofa or 2 armchairs for a chill night of TV. The covered balcony is furnished with a 6-person table and 2-person bistro set—perfect for alfresco dining or indulging in a sunset cocktail. This level has 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively. The third-floor bunk room is excellent for children with 2 full-over-full bunk beds, a private bathroom, 2 TVs, and a 4-person table for activities or board games. On the balcony, catch glimpses of the glimmering Gulf waters from rocking chairs. Across the pool deck, the private Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, a living space with a queen sleeper sofa, a 2-person table, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed. Enjoy an amazing Seagrove Beach vacation at She Winds. Easily explore with on-site parking and 7 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, take the crosswalk to the right of the property, and Dothan Beach Access will be at the end of Dothan Avenue. Book today!
